title: Passage 24
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Body confidence is when someone accepts and behaves kindly towards their body.
sentences.cn: 身体自信是指一个人接受并善待自己的身体。

sentences.en: That includes our size and shape, skin colour, appearance and any physical disabilities.
sentences.cn: 这包括我们的体型、肤色、外貌以及任何身体缺陷。

sentences.en: Jade Parnell from the Centre for Appearance Research says that having body confidence is about being accepting of your body and what it does for you.
sentences.cn: 外貌研究中心的杰德·帕内尔说，拥有身体自信是“接受你的身体以及它为你所做的一切”。

sentences.en: If you feel positively about your body,
sentences.cn: 如果你对自己的身体持积极态度，

sentences.en: you are more likely to take part in activities and perform well in school.
sentences.cn: 你更有可能参加活动并在学校表现出色。

sentences.en: However, a sense of body shame could make you step back, do less well at school and even feel down.
sentences.cn: 然而，身体羞耻感可能让你退缩，在学校表现欠佳，甚至感到沮丧。

sentences.en: The cost of trying to achieve the perfect appearance is high and not worth the effort.
sentences.cn: 试图达到完美外貌的代价很高，不值得花费力气。

sentences.en: Nobody is ever perfect.
sentences.cn: 没有人是完美的。

sentences.en: Even those who seem handsome or beautiful have things they hate about themselves.
sentences.cn: 即使那些看起来英俊或美丽的人也有自己讨厌的身体部位。

sentences.en: Parnell says, "If you're always trying to look a certain way, you will have less time to make important memories."
sentences.cn: 帕内尔说：“如果你总是试图让自己看起来符合某种特定的样子，你创造重要回忆的时间就会减少。”

sentences.en: It's important to realise that everybody is different, and we all belong to this society.
sentences.cn: 每个人都是不同的，我们都属于这个社会，明白这一点很重要。

sentences.en: To develop a positive body image, Parnell says, "Try not to pay too much attention to the clothes you wear."
sentences.cn: 为了塑造积极的身体形象，帕内尔说：“尽量不要太关注你所穿的衣服。”

sentences.en: Of course you can express your personal fashion,
sentences.cn: 当然，无论你喜欢衬衫和短裤，还是更经典的服装如西装，你都可以展现个人时尚。

sentences.en: whether you prefer shirts and shorts,
sentences.cn: 当然，无论你喜欢衬衫和短裤，还是更经典的服装如西装，你都可以展现个人时尚。

sentences.en: or something more classic like a suit.
sentences.cn: 当然，无论你喜欢衬衫和短裤，还是更经典的服装如西装，你都可以展现个人时尚。

sentences.en: But you may also think about what your body does for you.
sentences.cn: 但你也可以想想你的身体为你做了什么。

sentences.en: Do your legs make you run really fast?
sentences.cn: 你的双腿能让你跑得很快吗？

sentences.en: Are you good at sports like volleyball?
sentences.cn: 你擅长像排球这样的运动吗？

sentences.en: She also suggests treating your body well by doing training, having fun,
sentences.cn: 她还建议善待自己的身体：多做锻炼，享受乐趣，去远足，保证充足睡眠。

sentences.en: going for a hike and getting plenty of sleep.
sentences.cn: 她还建议善待自己的身体：多做锻炼，享受乐趣，去远足，保证充足睡眠。

sentences.en: Remember that you are a lovely person no matter how you look.
sentences.cn: 记住，无论你的外表如何，你都是一个可爱的人。
